title: Canonical staff and shift simulation lifecycle
goal: Make a hired campaign worker appear in the canonical staff roster and persist schedule, attendance, and work history across worker and manager views

in: Bridge campaign hire/onboarding to canonical staff member and staff_shifts persistence.
Verify manager and worker schedule, attendance, and completed work history through UI.
out: Treating tours.settings.crew_shifts fallback as a pass.

acceptance_criteria: Hired worker has authorized canonical staff row and persisted staff_shifts row.
Manager and worker see the same assignment after reload.
Check-in/out and completion update manager operations and worker history.
Foreign user and unassigned worker cannot read or mutate the shift.

commands: npx vitest run __tests__/logistics/logistics-route-contract.test.ts (read-only run; admin lane owns the suite)
evidence: Wave 34: 43 test files / 231 tests pass across __tests__/jobs/ + __tests__/hiring/ + __tests__/work-mode/, including the shift-lifecycle suites (staff-shift-assignment-sync, event-tour-staffing-repair, worker-ops) and the 8 work-mode history tests.

Worker half of the persisted shift verified by reading lib/work-mode/read-model.ts:120-175: getWorkModeAssignments reads employment_assignments server-side scoped eq(user_id, userId) with ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUSES, resolves canonical staff_shifts by the assignment's staff_shift_id, and derives event id, tour and start/end times from the shift when the assignment row does not carry them. That is the row a manager writes and the worker reads back.

No product change: the hire-to-shift bridge itself lives in app/admin/dashboard/{staff,hiring}/ and app/api/venue/**, which Wave 34 assigns to the admin and venue lanes. The work agent did not edit them.

Crew/roster replacement settled on the database lane's evidence and re-verified here: organization_people is the crew/contractor destination and staff_members (20260823070000_staff_members_canonical_roster.sql) is the canonical roster; VEN-103 marks venue_team_members LEGACY. get_staff_dashboard_stats exists only in supabase/migrations/archive/enhanced_staff_management_schema.sql and migrations_backup/ and must not be migrated forward.

Zero-importer claim independently re-derived for lib/venue/staff-management.service.ts (get_staff_dashboard_stats consumer): no importer in the repository, so the venue lane can delete it rather than repoint it.

What the work lane did do is verify the worker half of the same persisted shift locally and settle the crew/roster replacement evidence: getWorkModeAssignments (lib/work-mode/read-model.ts:120-175) reads employment_assignments server-side scoped eq(user_id, userId), resolves canonical staff_shifts for context, and derives event/tour/times from the shift when the assignment row does not carry them - so a persisted staff_shifts row is what the worker actually sees after reload.
